job.title: AI Product Engineer (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: AI Product Engineer – Java, APIs and generative AI in daily delivery
job.email_body:
Dear Paulina Müller,

You need an engineer who turns business needs into AI-powered products – I combine 5+ years of Java/API engineering with extensive daily use of generative AI and LLM tools at Rockwell Automation.

– Generative AI and prompt engineering across analysis, development, testing and documentation
– Requirements, user stories and functional specs with business stakeholders
– REST APIs, microservices and ERP/PIM/MDM integrations taken to production via CI/CD cycles

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My CV and cover letter are attached. My profile combines technical depth with close work alongside business teams, and I would bring exactly this experience to your team. Could we schedule a short call in the coming days?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan
https://www.linkedin.com/in/kranti-chavan-84a155191

tailoring.headline: AI Product Engineer | Java, APIs & Generative AI | From Requirements to Production
tailoring.summary: Product-minded software engineer with 5+ years building enterprise platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, who uses generative AI and LLM tools extensively across analysis, development, testing and documentation. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices and integrations between ERP, PIM and MDM systems. Works techno-functionally with business stakeholders: turns requirements into user stories, functional specifications and solution designs, and takes them into production via CI/CD deployment cycles. Prompt engineering, code reviews and agile delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Bayard builds AI products for real client problems – the meeting point of business understanding, solid engineering and generative AI that defines my current role. A consulting environment where AI moves from idea to production is exactly where I want to apply my techno-functional and API experience.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Paulina, I applied for the AI Product Engineer role: 5+ years Java/Spring, REST APIs and integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, with generative AI and LLM tools in my daily delivery. Karlsruhe, start 16.12.2026. Happy to have a short call!

en.subject: Application: AI Product Engineer
en.hook: An AI product engineer has to do two things well: understand what the business really needs, and ship software that uses AI to deliver it. Both are my daily work: at Rockwell Automation I translate business requirements into enterprise solutions and use generative AI and LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing and documentation – backed by more than five years of Java, API and integration engineering.

bullets.label: AI-assisted engineering
bullets.text: Used generative AI / LLM tools and prompt engineering extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing and documentation in an enterprise delivery team.

bullets.label: Product thinking
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role with business stakeholders: analysed requirements, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into working solutions.

bullets.label: APIs & backend
bullets.text: Developed and exposed REST web services (headless APIs) for frontends and third-party consumers with Java and Spring; engineered API migrations that improved stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Integration & data
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM platforms and resolved integration bottlenecks with international technical teams.

en.logistics: I bring a pragmatic view on where AI genuinely speeds up delivery and where solid engineering matters most. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, am open to Cologne or hybrid setups and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can help Bayard build AI products that reach production.
en.contact: Attn. Paulina Müller, Bayard Consulting GmbH
